Mod.json.name: The Only Cure+ (Field Surgery)
Mod.json.description: Fork of The Only Cure: staged field surgery with real risk, visible infection window, sepsis, prosthesis tiers, leg amputations with crutches, crawler zombies.

Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_SurgeonAbilityImportance: Relevance of surgeon First Aid ability
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_CureWindow_tooltip: Amputating while the Knox infection is below this percentage always cures it. Default 20.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_LateGambleWindow: Late gamble window (percent of infection progress)
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_LateGambleWindow_tooltip: Between the cure window and this value the cure becomes a gamble that gets worse every hour. 0 disables the gamble.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_ShowSymptoms_tooltip: Chills, sweat and fever messages as the infection advances. They are the only hint you get.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_DiagnosisMinDoctor: First Aid level needed to examine a wound
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_DiagnosisMinDoctor_tooltip: Right-click a bite or scratch in the health panel to get a (fallible) opinion. The Field Amputation Guide also allows it.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_RevealOutcome: Reveal the outcome right after the surgery
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_RevealOutcome_tooltip: Off: you find out whether you were in time the hard way.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_SurgeryRiskMultiplier_toolti: Scales the chance of a rough or botched amputation. 0 makes every surgery clean.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_ScreamRadius_tooltip: How far a patient without anaesthesia is heard. Zombies will come.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_DropSeveredLimbs: Drop the severed limb on the floor
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_EnableLegAmputations_tooltip: Feet, lower legs and thighs can be amputated. Walking then needs a crutch or a prosthetic leg.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_SepsisEnabled_tooltip: A dirty stump gets infected (vanilla wound infection), causes fever and can kill. Clean it with alcohol and take antibiotics.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_ConvalescenceDays_tooltip: Days of weakness, hunger and tiredness after an amputation.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_CarryPenalty: Carry weight penalty without a hand
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_ProsthesisWear_tooltip: Every action wears the prosthesis; repair it with glue, tape, welding rods or screws before it breaks.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_ZombieCrawlerOnLegHit: Zombies that lose a leg become crawlers
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_SleepingPillAnesthesia_toolt: How much sleeping pills can count towards anaesthesia during surgery, in percent (0 = they do not count). Painkillers count up to 60 and alcohol up to 50.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_SelfAmputationHigh: Self-amputation above the elbow and knee
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_SelfAmputationHigh_tooltip: Lets a survivor cut off their own upper arm or thigh. Much more likely to fail or to faint halfway.
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_CrutchStaminaDrain_tooltip: Extra stamina used while walking on a crutch, in percent of the default (100 = tired after about a minute of walking without rest, 0 = no extra cost).
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_CrawlStaminaDrain_tooltip: Extra stamina used while crawling, in percent of the default (100 = tired after about 40 seconds, 0 = no extra cost).
Sandbox.json.Sandbox_TOC_AmputeeTraitStaminaDrain_too: Characters who start with a leg amputee trait already know how to use crutches: their crutch and crawling stamina cost is this percent of the values above (50 = half).
